name: rate-card
title: Rate card
description: Metered pricing as a plain table: each resource with what is included free, then the price per unit, so developers can estimate without a calculator.
docs: Pass the groups (a title and rows of resource, included, rate, unit and an optional note), billing (how the product is billed, in words), checkedOn (the day the prices were checked) and the currency and locale. billing and checkedOn are required on purpose: they are the caption, and a rate card that does not say how old it is goes stale unnoticed. Included may be a number, written in the locale, or text such as 10 GB or Unlimited, and null says nothing is included. A numeric rate is written as money with up to four digits for a fraction of a cent, followed by per and the unit; 0 reads as Free, null as no extra charge, and text such as Custom is shown as written. The table is semantic, with the caption, column headers, a header row for every group and a row header for every resource. Under 672px the rows become stacked blocks that keep their column names, so nothing scrolls sideways, and explicit roles keep it a table for a screen reader in both layouts. It needs no client JavaScript. labels translates every fixed word.
